## Problem and change / Problema y cambio

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link related issues with `Closes #...` where appropriate.
Puedes escribir en español.

## Validation / Validación

List the commands you ran and their results. State which checks were not run and why.
For UI changes, include sanitised before/after screenshots at desktop and mobile widths.
For infrastructure changes, describe affected resources, compatibility, possible costs and any migration or data-loss implications. Do not attach real plans or state.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, with relevant validation or regression tests.
- [ ] Examples and documentation are updated where behaviour changed.
- [ ] User-facing text is available in English and Spanish, where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, real Azure configuration, customer data, state, plans or archives are included.
- [ ] Existing licence and third-party notices are preserved.

See [Contributing](https://github.com/danieljsaldana/goliat-nexus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) / [Cómo contribuir](https://github.com/danieljsaldana/goliat-nexus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.es.md).
Report vulnerabilities through [private reporting](https://github.com/danieljsaldana/goliat-nexus/security/advisories/new).
